profile.headline: Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase & Co.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented REST APIs using Spring Boot, ReactJS, and Postgres for an internal Anti-Money Laundering (AML) ecosystem.  
• Collaborated with stakeholders and QA testers to enhance and optimize the AML ecosystem for scalability and performance.
• Improved system reliability by implementing JUnit, Jest, and acceptance test suites, increasing code coverage to 90% and reducing production defects
• Delivered automation for FIU alert and case blueprint fields, reducing redundant data entry and saving approximately 400 hours per month in operational effort for compliance teams
• Implemented input sanitization using OWASP HTML Sanitization
positions.insights: Apache Kafka and Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Maintained 99.9% uptime for internal Discover applications by managing and optimizing Kafka-based messaging systems
• Built a Kafka consumer failover service in Java to automatically determine failover across multi-region clusters, improving resilience for enterprise messaging systems
• Deployed applications in OpenShift/Kubernetes across east and west regions, ensuring multi-cluster resilience and high availability
• Developed a GitHub-scraping tool to restore lost Kafka schemas in a high-stakes staging environment, cutting manual recovery time by ~90% and improving reliability

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed a Warehouse Management PowerApp, enabling warehouse workers to efficiently track and manage inventory
• Collaborated with teammates to design an intuitive and user-friendly PowerApp layout
• Developed a supplemental training plan to educate Crowe employees on Microsoft PowerApps, improving internal adoption rates

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed REST APIs using Spring Boot and Kafka to automate Kafka administrative operations
• Deployed applications in OpenShift/Kubernetes, integrated DevOps pipelines with Jenkins, and ensured code quality through SonarQube and Nexus IQ.
• Practiced Agile development methodologies, actively participating in daily standups, sprint planning, and retrospectives to drive project success

volunteerExperiences.description: A Caring Community Empowering Student Success (ACCESS) is a program that helps aid freshmen throughout their first year of high school with the use of older mentors. Access takes place after school, teaching freshman valuable skills like finding career interests, time management, etc, and also tutor students who need aid in certain topics.
